name: Building Relationships
overview: Scripture reveals that building relationships is essential to God's design, beginning with His declaration that it is not good for man to be alone and providing a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). The union of marriage exemplifies this relational bond, where a man leaves his parents and cleaves to his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). True friendship is marked by steadfast love and faithfulness, even through adversity and honest correction (Proverbs 17:17; 27:6). Ultimately, the greatest expression of love in relationships is sacrificial, as demonstrated by Christ’s giving of Himself for His friends (John 3:16; 15:13).
